title: Spark - Idea Exploration & Validation Bootcamp
description: SPARK – Idea Exploration & Validation Bootcamp is a 5-day program organized by Vignan’s Centre for Innovations and Startups in collaboration with the Ratan Tata Innovation Hub (RTIH). It focuses on innovation, design thinking, ideation, expert mentoring, business validation, pitching, and prototyping, helping students transform innovative ideas into viable startup concepts. Top ideas may also receive Government of Andhra Pradesh funding support, subject to evaluation.

title: Eureka 2026
description: EUREKA! Pitch Competition 2026 is an innovation and entrepreneurship event presented by Vignan’s Institute of Information Technology. The competition invites participants to showcase innovative ideas, pitch their solutions, and create meaningful impact. The event is scheduled for 24th August, with teams of up to 4 members, and encourages students to “Innovate, Pitch, Inspire.”
